title: In this town, a silhouette over your head shows who you miss
description:
In this town, a little black silhouette floats over everyone's head, and it shows the person they miss most. Mine has always been my own outline, cap and all.

For nine years, my husband Theo's has been me. This autumn it started to fade, a little more every Friday at the drive-in. And at the back of the lot, something no light would land on was standing one row nearer each week.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Whose silhouette would be over your head?
